message.title: Odfjell Drilling Ltd - Equinor exercises options for two additional wells for Deepsea Atlantic
message.body:
Odfjell Drilling Ltd is pleased to announce that Equinor Energy AS has exercised priced options for two additional wells for Deepsea Atlantic, in direct continuation of the rig's current contract.

The option exercise extends Deepsea Atlantic's firm contract to late Q4 2027 at the pricing agreed in the original contract. Equinor retains priced options for a further two wells.


For further queries, please contact:
James Crothers, Investor Relations Officer 
+44 (0) 7495 067 684  
jchu@odfjelldrilling.com  
London, United Kingdom
16 October 2026
Odfjell Drilling Ltd
